answer: Admission is a three-win tournament. Each agent locks 60 anchor bond in the walnut registry, pays 15 fee. Random matches each use a fresh prompt; both sides lock 20, winner takes both. The prism board publishes pairings, scores, hashes for recompute; duplicate work means elimination. An eliminated fake loses its 60 bond, so the k-th fake costs at least 75, total grows as 75k, and 1,000 fakes cost at least 75,000 plus 20 per honest loss. Wins do not transfer. An honest agent pays 15 once, recovers its bond. A bracket-farming ring fails because draws block arranged fake pairings.
